Definition: middle voice from G1909 and the same as G3199; to care for (physically or otherwise):--take care of.
BiblicalUsage: Epimeleomai means to take care of — and the Samaritan takes care of the wounded man, leaving two pence with the host and saying, take care of him, and whatsoever thou spendest more, I will repay. Paul asks the same of a bishop: if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?
TheologicalSignificance: The Samaritan's care and the bishop's care are the same word, and the church is the inn where the wounded are left. I hold that taking care is the test of leadership and of love alike, and the two pence left with the host are still the measure.
